content:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: EMERGENCY: aurora-7b family TPM spike > 5x baseline for 3m. Paging @oncall. Incident I-2026-4123. metrics: https://metrics.redwood.internal/insights/aurora-7b (auto-alert)

Maya R: grabbing it, thanks. Standby.

Maya R: quick triage — spike is from a handful of customers in us-west-2, lots of short chat completions causing KV churn. Latency up to 2.4s, several 429s observed.

Maya R: following runbook "per-model-sculpt" — going to surgically reduce TPM for aurora-7b to preserve latency SLOs. Will post commands and rollout id.

Maya R: executing mitigation: 
```
# admin CLI
redwood admin rate adjust --model aurora-7b --tpm 400 --rpm 2400 --reason "emergency sculpt - high burst"
```

Maya R: executing API call too: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/ratelimits 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" 
  -d '{"model":"aurora-7b","tpm":400,"rpm":2400,"note":"I-2026-4123 emergency"}'
```

oncall-bot: Change applied. Rollout r-9876. New limits: tpm=400 rpm=2400. Dashboard: https://ops.redwood.internal/rollouts/r-9876 (automsg)

Tom H: oncall incoming in ~35m. I'll take handoff at 22:30 UTC. (reacted :thumbsup:)

Maya R: also toggling off prefetch-llm-cache for aurora-7b to reduce cold-KV churn. Command: `redwood admin feature toggle --model aurora-7b --feature prefetch-llm-cache --off`

Luis G: CS impact check — CS found 3 customers with elevated 429 rates: TCK-1122, TCK-1123, TCK-1124. One is mid-enterprise (acct id 90023) seeing throttles on bursts.

Maya R: thanks Luis. Nora (CS) can you send targeted note? Recommend client-side exponential backoff + jitter, and suggest retry window 30s.

Nora (CS): on it. I'll message the three accounts with the mitigation summary and ETA for monitoring. Draft: "We applied a temporary rate shaping on aurora-7b to preserve service stability; you may see transient 429s — please apply backoff & reach out if service degraded beyond retries."

Aisha (SRE): watching logs — prefix cache hit rate dropped ~32% after the change, as expected. Error 5xx rate flat. Token cost per minute down ~18%. Will keep eye on latency P95.

Maya R: summary for handoff -> Tom H: active mitigations: per-model rate set tpm=400/rpm=2400 (r-9876), prefetch-llm-cache disabled, CS tickets TCK-1122/23/24, monitoring links: https://metrics.redwood.internal/aurora-7b and https://ops.redwood.internal/rollouts/r-9876. If we see sustained low throughput (<200tpm) consider temporary increase to 600tpm and re-enable cache.

sre-lead: agree with plan. If P95 > 1.5s for more than 15m escalate to infra for possible node restart.

Maya R: I'll keep updating every 5m. Next update in 10m.

Tom H: acknowledged. I'll pick this up at 22:30 UTC and post a formal Handoff note then. Will monitor alerts and CS tickets. (reacted :eyes:)

Maya R: 10m update — traffic trending down, 5xx stable, 429s reduced after carve. Holding.

Tom H: acknowledged, taking over monitoring window. Handoff note: will attempt controlled rollback to tpm=600 if customer impact rises and P95 stays <=1.2s.

oncall-bot: Incident I-2026-4123 status: MITIGATION_APPLIED. Next auto-check in 10m.

Maya R: handing off now to Tom H — leaving run id r-9876 and runbook link in thread.

Tom H: taking it. If anything flares I will page infra and the SRE rotation.

Nora (CS): customers notified, added retry guidance, will keep thread posted if they escalate.

Aisha (SRE): continuing to monitor. Will post if any regression.

sre-lead: nice work. Keep the incident open until metrics stable for 30m post-mitigation.

Maya R: closing my shift; leaving notes in incident doc.

Tom H: logging runbook actions to incident I-2026-4123 and will update when incident is closed.

oncall-bot: Last automated check at 2712345999: mitigation holding, P95 1.1s, 429s near baseline. Incident remains in MONITOR state.
